name: CLI-Anything local harnesses
what: A family of local command-line harnesses that let an agent drive real creative software on the user's machine: Inkscape, GIMP, Krita, Blender, FreeCAD, draw.io, LibreOffice, MLT video, QGIS, SoX, OBS and a local ComfyUI. Each harness prints JSON and writes project files. Most send nothing out and spend nothing. The per-program list, pins and probes live in kit/catalogs/local-clis.json.
install: One harness at a time, after the user says yes. Print the pinned command with local_clis.py install <id>; it installs from the upstream commit pinned in local-clis.json. The program itself (for example inkscape or blender) is the user's install.
firstCall: python3 <ask-gdh skill folder>/scripts/local_clis.py probe --json, to list which harnesses and programs are on PATH
evidenceNote: On 2026-11-27 the upstream repository was read at commit 34f519533bc1: the Apache-2.0 license, the security policy, the registry and the 16 harness folders in local-clis.json. The probe script ran in a GDH session and found no harness installed. No harness was installed or run, so every capability claim is DOCUMENTED. The PyPI builds of eight harnesses date from 2026-03-13, before later upstream fixes, so GDH pins the commit instead. exposes is true because the Mermaid harness renders through a web service.
